nodes.description: Address of the current contract owner, set in the Owned constructor from msg.sender.
Pending new owner address used by the two-step ownership transfer (transferOwnership/acceptOwnership).
ERC20 token symbol 'DOSAMIGOS', set in the token constructor.
ERC20 token name 'DosAmigos', set in the token constructor.
ERC20 decimals value (18).
_totalSupply, the total number of minted token units.
mapping(address => uint) balances, canonical holder balances.
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) allowed, ERC20 allowance table.
SafeMath.safeAdd(uint a, uint b): c = a + b with require(c >= a) overflow check.
SafeMath.safeSub(uint a, uint b): require(b <= a) then c = a - b.
SafeMath.safeMul(uint a, uint b): c = a * b with require(a == 0 || c / a == b).
SafeMath.safeDiv(uint a, uint b): require(b > 0) then c = a / b.
Owned constructor that assigns owner = msg.sender.
onlyOwner modifier performing require(msg.sender == owner).
transferOwnership(address _newOwner) guarded by onlyOwner, writes newOwner.
acceptOwnership() requires msg.sender == newOwner, promotes newOwner to owner and clears newOwner.
DosAmigos token constructor: sets metadata and mints the total supply to a fixed address.
totalSupply() returns _totalSupply - balances[address(0)].
balanceOf(address tokenOwner) returns balances[tokenOwner].
transfer(address to, uint tokens) moves tokens from msg.sender to 'to' using safeSub/safeAdd.
approve(address spender, uint tokens) writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens) moves tokens using the caller allowance.
allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender) returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
approveAndCall(address spender, uint tokens, bytes data) sets allowance then calls spender.receiveApproval externally.
Payable fallback function that unconditionally reverts.
transferAnyERC20Token(address tokenAddress, uint tokens) onlyOwner external call to ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer.
msg.sender, attacker-controlled caller used for ownership, balance indexing and allowance indexing.
Unsigned addition c = a + b in safeAdd guarded only by require(c >= a).
Unsigned subtraction c = a - b in safeSub guarded by require(b <= a).
Unsigned multiplication c = a * b in safeMul guarded by division check.
Unsigned division c = a / b in safeDiv guarded by require(b > 0).
safeSub(balances[msg.sender], tokens) subtraction of sender balance in transfer.
safeAdd(balances[to], tokens) addition to recipient balance in transfer.
safeSub(balances[from], tokens) subtraction of holder balance in transferFrom.
safeSub(allowed[from][msg.sender], tokens) subtraction of allowance in transferFrom.
safeAdd(balances[to], tokens) addition to recipient balance in transferFrom.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(msg.sender, tokens, this, data) to an arbitrary address supplied by the caller.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) to an arbitrary token address.
Access control check require(msg.sender == owner) inside the onlyOwner modifier.
Access control check require(msg.sender == newOwner) inside acceptOwnership.
Unconditional revert() in the payable fallback function.
Unsigned subtraction _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] in totalSupply().

safeSub performs the unsigned subtraction c = a - b that can underflow before the require check.

safeDiv performs the unsigned division c = a / b guarded by b > 0.
